node.html:
• Designed and implemented RESTful APIs to integrate SAP and Salesforce via Mulesoft, automating product pricing retrieval and service order creation. Improved data synchronization for real-time updates, reducing manual data entry and enhancing system reliability by 60%.

  • Collaborated with the business, cross-functional teams (SAP and Mulesoft) to understand business processes, gather business requirements, perform design reviews and develop new software solutions in salesforce. This result in achieving $60,000 savings quarterly.

  • Built the Amendment and Renewal functionalities for orders by implementing scalable Java & Visualforce logic, refining system workflows, and reducing manual intervention by 40%, resulting in improved order processing efficiency.

  • Spearheaded a team of 5, assigned technical tasks following agile methodologies for efficient workflow management, mentored in developing solutions, and conducted code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices, enhancing code quality, team collaboration and reducing project delivery timelines by 20%.

  • Integrated Olympus’s Sales and Service processes using Salesforce and SAP, enabling seamless service opt-in during equipment purchases. This reduced order creation steps by 60% and boosted revenue by $80,000+ per month.

  • Built 5+ PoCs for projects using CPQ, Java and SQL to assess development feasibility and optimize design decisions which helped TCS to expedite project delivery speed.

  • Designed and implemented a data pipeline using Mulesoft for seamless data transfer between Salesforce and SAP source systems enhancing real-time data availability and data access to users by reducing data transfer latency by 60%

  • Throughout this experience, I utilized my strong skills in Java, LWC, Visualforce, Salesforce, SQL, software development, and Agile methodologies to successfully deliver these projects.

frontmatter.title: Software Engineer I

node.html:
• Ensured bug-free deployments and smooth project go-lives through QA, integration testing and unit testing, developing over 50 java test classes to debug and resolve critical issues in code, reducing post deployment errors by 95%.

  • Automated Order approvals and quote document generation using flows & triggers, improving user experience by 90%.

  • Received the "Best Customer Service award" for resolving 300+ critical defects in the Quote-to-Order process using Java and SQL, improving system performance by 60% and user satisfaction.

  • Developed technical documentation for key objects, classes, and triggers, optimizing application architecture, cloud infrastructure and integration calls (API) to achieve a 90% reduction in system load enhancing operational efficiency.

  • Orchestrated 400+ successful live deployments leveraging GIT and Flosum and 200+ Master data update activities through Workbench, implementing robust version control practices that maintained synchronization between production and testing environments, significantly streamlining CI/CD processes and reducing deployment failures by 35%.

  • Implemented SQL-driven reports & dashboards on home page delivering regular data driven insights related to trends in sales & service orders to clients leading to a 75% increase in strategic decision-making & service delivery.

  • Extracted 500+ business objects data from the database, applied SQL for data transformations, cleaning & loaded data into production using Workbench to launch a contract leading to a 70% improvement in data consistency & data governance.

Image classification project focuses on classifying images from the CIFAR-10 dataset using various machine learning & deep learning models, including logistic regression, decision trees, convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and transformers. The models were trained and evaluated to compare their performance using standard metrics like accuracy. Deep learning models, particularly ResNet-18 and CCT, significantly outperformed traditional models.

Dominick's Finer Foods is a retail business located in Chicago. DFF has 100+ stores and 25+ product categories. DFF wants to improve their business by understanding their stores and products performance. I created a data warehouse using SQL Server & SSMS, structured it using star schema, implemented ETL pipelines leveraging SSIS, loaded data into data warehouse and pulled valuable insights which are key for DFF's growth. Check it out!

The main objective of the project is to perform a comprehensive regression analysis to assess obesity levels in individuals as a function of various demographic, dietary, and lifestyle parameters. By analyzing the relationships between predictors and the target variable (obesity levels), this project aims to build reliable regression models to estimate obesity levels, providing valuable insights into public health and nutrition management.

The project objective is to explore the relationship between various lifestyle factors such as physical activity, stress levels, and occupation and their impact on sleep duration and quality. I performed data preprocessing to clean the dataset and EDA to uncover actionable insights that can guide individuals toward better sleep habits and help healthcare professionals identify high-risk groups for sleep disorders.

Designed and developed a POS relational database using MariaDB, SQL on AWS EC2 instance to manage 75,000+ customers & their orders data and run analytics. Performed ETL operations to load data into POS. Utilized database views to provide easy access to customers, indexes, materialized views, stored procedures and triggers to improve database performance. Performed standard replication and peer-to-Peer clustering to improve read and write operations of the database. Later migrated entire data to MongoDB to run advanced analytics.

Performed data preprocessing and merged COVID-19 and World Happiness datasets using Python. Performed comprehensive Exploratory Data Analysis to uncover valuable insights. Developed 15+ advanced visualizations with Seaborn to elucidate complex data relationships, significantly improving stakeholder insights.

This case study explores emerging technologies in finance and insurance industry, focusing on Federated Machine Learning, Reinforcement Learning, Cloud Native Computing, and Graph Data Science. It highlights fraud detection, pricing optimization, compliance, and risk assessment, along with IT initiatives, implementation strategies, and associated risks.

The main aim of the project is to perform data analysis on UK Bank Customers. Performed data cleaning and created an interactive dashboard using Tableau, leveraging charts to visualize data by balance, age, gender, and job classification. Crafted a compelling dashboard storyline that highlighted critical regional demographics and balance trends, driving a 35% improvement in ad-hoc financial and operations reporting.

Designed and developed a scrum product canvas comprising product vision, metrics/KPIs, epic, user stories, storyboard, burndown chart and sprint planning resulting in a clear and actionable roadmap for product development. Crafted wireframes, and mockups using Figma to create an intuitive app interface. Utilized product canvas to manage stakeholders’ requirements, prioritize features, and draft flow, use cases, UML diagrams.
